description: In the Persian tradition of Fal-e Hafez, one asks a question, opens the Divan of Hafez at random, and takes the poem that appears as a message from fate. Ask Hafez brings that tradition online, with a short, plain-English reading of each poem.
sharePrefix: A verse drawn for me today:
pauseBody: Hold a question or intention in your mind. Breathe slowly, and when you feel ready, reveal your fortune.
